name: Groteskly Yours Studio · GYS Pixels

title.zh: Groteskly Yours Studio · 比较字族样张

description.zh: 看Pixels实际点阵字样和400PT等原控件。 Groteskly Yours字体目录展示Strekka、Alfold等字族样张，具体GYS Pixels页可见像素字形和Variable控件。须分别核对零售、Trial与Pixels免费许可，字体嵌入、修改和再分发均有对应限制。
description.en: Groteskly Yours presents retail typeface specimens including Strekka and Alfold. Its GYS Pixels page renders a pixel sample with variable controls. Retail licensing, evaluation trials and the free GYS Pixels offer need separate checks; its embedding, modification and redistribution limits still apply.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Groteskly Yours Studio (https://groteskly.xyz/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Pixels实际点阵字样和400PT等原控件。

Visual details from source observation: 我们从首页确认字厂，再到All Fonts看Strekka与Alfold两张完整样张；下行只见Pixels和Lader名称，不能算四款都已看完。Pixels的Variable区已渲染Type here点阵字样及400PT控件，本次没打字、拖滑杆或下载。零售、Trial和Pixels免费许可分开，免费字体也禁止部分嵌入、修改和再分发，不能当开源字体。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
